targets.query:
from(bucket:"sensor_data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "°C" and r._field == "value" and r.entity_id == "badezimmer_temperature")
  |> group()
  |> reduce(
      identity: {Min: 1000.0, Max: -1000.0, sum: 0.0, n: 0.0},
      fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
        Min: if r._value < accumulator.Min then r._value else accumulator.Min,
        Max: if r._value > accumulator.Max then r._value else accumulator.Max,
        sum: accumulator.sum + r._value,
        n: accumulator.n + 1.0
      }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Min: r.Min, Max: r.Max, Avg: r.sum / r.n}))
  |> rename(columns: {Avg: "Ø"})

from(bucket:"sensor_data")
  |> range(start: -30d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "draussen_battery_state" and r._field == "state")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])

b30 = from(bucket:"sensor_data_30m")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "°C" and r._field == "value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with friendly_name:
        if r.entity_id == "lumi_lumi_weather_temperatur" or r.entity_id == "badezimmer_temperature" then "Badezimmer"
        else if r.entity_id == "lumi_lumi_weather_temperatur_2" or r.entity_id == "flur_temperature" then "Flur"
        else if r.entity_id == "lumi_lumi_weather_temperatur_3" or r.entity_id == "kueche_temperature" then "Küche"
        else if r.entity_id == "lumi_lumi_weather_temperatur_4" or r.entity_id == "schlafzimmer_temperature" then "Schlafzimmer"
        else if r.entity_id == "lumi_lumi_weather_temperatur_5" or r.entity_id == "wohnzimmer_temperature" then "Wohnzimmer"
        else "Nicht bekannt"
    }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.friendly_name != "Nicht bekannt")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> duplicate(column: "friendly_name", as: "_field")
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])
